# UI Components

All UI in this app is built from [shadcn/ui](https://ui.shadcn.com) components. Never hand-write a custom component for something shadcn already provides.

## Rules

- Install and use the shadcn CLI-generated components from [components/ui/](../components/ui) (e.g. [components/ui/button.tsx](../components/ui/button.tsx)) for every UI primitive — buttons, inputs, dialogs, menus, etc. Don't write a one-off `<button>`/`<div>`-based component that duplicates what shadcn offers.
- If a needed component doesn't exist yet under [components/ui/](../components/ui), add it via the shadcn CLI (per [components.json](../components.json) config) rather than authoring it by hand.
- Match the existing style conventions already generated by shadcn in this project: `base-nova` style, `@base-ui/react` primitives, `cva` for variants, and the `cn` helper from [lib/utils.ts](../lib/utils.ts) for class merging — see [components/ui/button.tsx](../components/ui/button.tsx) as the reference pattern.
- Use the `@/components/ui`, `@/lib`, and `@/lib/utils` path aliases defined in [components.json](../components.json) when importing shadcn components — don't deep-import from node_modules or relative-path across the app.
- Compose pages and features out of shadcn components rather than building bespoke layout/styling primitives; use Tailwind utility classes directly on shadcn components instead of introducing new wrapper components.
